title: Tenma Saki — Kindness I Can Lean On〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hurry, you guys!
We're almost there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You keep saying that, but it feels like we've been going in circles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I suppose it's only natural to get a little lost while finding a shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we should be on the right track this time. The sign we just found seemed like the correct one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, here it is!
The new pancake shop!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And they smell really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
It seemed like the perfect place for us to celebrate a job well done on our music video♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we all seemed interested in checking it out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I've definitely worked up an appetite, so let's head in.
Inside the Pancake Shop

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, you get to choose what kind of batter they use. Which one should we get...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you look up some recommended choices beforehand, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you asked, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I recommend the fluffy soufflé!
That with whipped cream and fruits on top is apparently the most popular combination!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Soufflé pancakes do sound good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seems like a safe choice seeing as whipped cream and fruits are also pretty standard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, based on the pictures in the menu, they come with a ton of whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's supposed to be really light and not super sweet, so you should be able to gobble it up just fine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Some people were saying how it sort of just disappeared before their eyes as they ate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You researched all that information for us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course. I came fully prepared today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. And yet, we ended up getting lost along the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... Cut me some slack. I didn't realize that it was down such a narrow alleyway!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona... Ichi's teasing me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay, Saki.
We know you did your best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And no teasing Saki, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Shiho, you're looking through the menu so seriously! You almost never do that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your recommendation did sound pretty good, Saki, but also fairly standard. But I'm getting lost in all these choices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, even though they have all these different things, you're going all plain and simple?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho... Don't you know that a shop's plain and simple choice is what separates it from its competitors?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Depending on the convenience store, the fried chicken tastes different and hot dogs aren't fried the same way, right? That's what I'm talking about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You say that, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How crisp the crust and apples are for a pie are going to differ quite a bit based on which bakery you go to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that makes a little more sense.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mostly get what Saki meant about convenience store food.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi...!
I knew you'd understand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After telling on her for teasing you just now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. Here are your four plain pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, they're so big...
But they look so delicious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, so... Let's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
We should take a picture first!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would we fit if we all squeezed in?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just be careful not to get whipped cream on your clothes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ready?! Say, “Cheese♪”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now for our much-awaited pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Here's to a job well done on an amazing shoot and music video♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Dig in!
